assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness in the setting of known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and atherosclerotic heart disease.
The diagnoses are paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0) and atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10).
The purpose of the mobile cardiac telemetry is to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to assess the efficacy of current rate control management.
The payer letter acknowledged the service as Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229).
The service was denied under PR-204.
The payer letter states the determination is based on Reason Code PR-204.
The payer letter states the service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan.
The payer letter states appeals must be submitted in writing within ninety days of the notice.
The payer letter states the payer_id is cornerstone.
